_about: John Locke (1632-1704). Clean Gutenberg: An Essay Concerning Humane Understanding, vol. 2 (based on the 2nd edition); vol. 1 (PG 10615) and the Second Treatise (PG 7370) are on the Adler shelf. Raw IA OCR: Some Thoughts Concerning Education, ed. R. H. Quick (Cambridge, 2nd ed., 1889). Added in round an: The Works of John Locke, a new edition, corrected, in ten volumes (London: Thomas Tegg and others, 1823), raw OCR of Google scans, all ten volumes from the one Tegg imprint. The OCR garbles the imprint year on vols. IV, V and X (1828, 'law', 1828); it is read as 1823 from the identical imprint and the library catalogue. Vols. I-III, V and IX overlap the Essay, the Second Treatise and the Quick Education held above and on the Adler shelf; the set is taken whole as the collected edition, and vol. VI supplies the Letters on Toleration that were wanted. No uids minted.
